explanation: The name comes from the Latin clavus, 'nail', after the bud's shape. Their numbing warmth, once used for toothache, comes from an oil called eugenol.

claims.text: Cloves are the dried flower buds of the clove tree, Syzygium aromaticum, native to the Maluku Islands (Spice Islands) of Indonesia.
Nutmeg is a seed, allspice a berry and star anise a fruit, so none is a dried flower bud.
The word clove comes, through French, from the Latin clavus, meaning nail, after the bud's shape.
Clove oil, rich in eugenol, has long been used to numb toothache.
